notes: A failed update check now shows a dismissible banner with the exact reason (e.g. proxy blocking the manifest URL) instead of failing silently — previously a blocked check looked identical to 'no update available'. Clearer error texts for the update check: they now name the manifest URL and distinguish unreachable / HTTP error / malformed manifest. The update banner's 'Open download folder' button works again — the published manifest was missing the SharePoint link. Field test of the update notification: if you can read this in the app, the banner worked. If a colleague doesn't see the banner, ask them for the new error banner text (or Changelog → Check for updates).
